newsitem.title: CHINA: SHANGHAI PDB PLANS US$50MLN 364-DAY ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: SHANGHAI PDB PLANS US$50MLN 364-DAY ISSUE.

text.p: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank plans to raise US$50 million through a 364-day floating rate certificate of deposit issue, bankers said on Tuesday.
The issue will carry a coupon of 23.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate, they said.
Although no other pricing details have been confirmed, one source suggested the bank would offer fees of five basis points, lifting the all-in for one year to 28.5 basis points.
Arrangers are Chase Manhattan Asia (books), Fuji International Finance, HSBC Markets (books, publicity) and Standard Chartered (agent).
The issue is expected later this month
